title: The Charter Is Raised
body: In Spring of Year {year}, the council raised its first banners at {site}. Eight known places formed the first map of the realm.

title: {site} Enters the Map
body: Scouts returned from {site} in {season} of Year {year}, adding {region} to the council's living map.

title: A New Year Opens
body: Year {year} began with the council still measuring promise against distance.

title: {site} Is Founded
body: In {season} of Year {year}, settlers raised a charter camp at {site}, carrying stores and hard promises into {region}.

title: {site} Grows
body: {site} crossed a new threshold in {season} of Year {year}, proving that a frontier holding could become something sturdier.

title: Hunger Reaches {site}
body: Food stores failed at {site} in {season} of Year {year}. Stability and loyalty began to bend under empty granaries.

title: {site} Is Abandoned
body: Neglect and hunger broke {site} in {season} of Year {year}. The chronicle marked the place as a warning to the realm.
